question: A person borrowed some money on simple interest. After 4 years. he returned (9)/(5) of the money to the lender. What was the rate of interest?
solution:
Given:

A person borrowed some money on simple interest. After 4 years. he returned (9)/(5) of the money to the lender.

Formula used:

Simple interest = P × R × T / 100 [ P = principal, R = rate of interest, T = time]

Calculation:

Let,R = rate of interest 

Principa is = P

The simple interest got by the person is 

⇒ 9P/5 - P = 4P/5

As per the formula,

⇒ 4P/5 = P × 4 × R / 100

⇒ R = 20%

∴ The correct option is **4**
